groups.defect: In the guest filter in addGuests.handler.ts (lines 74-78), guest emails are compared case-sensitively against the lowercased blacklist and the existing attendee emails. A guest email in different casing can get past the blacklist and can be added again as a duplicate of an existing attendee. The fix is to normalize guest emails (trim and lowercase) before comparing.

answer.reasoning: All three suggestions point at the same filter in addGuests.handler.ts (lines 70-78) and name the same root cause: `guest` is never normalized before it is compared with the lowercased blacklist and with `attendee.email`. The fix is the same for all three: normalize the guest email once. s_2eda8d39 focuses on the blacklist bypass, but it also says to use the normalized value for duplicate checks. s_0f78e9fc and s_969329e8 each cover both the blacklist bypass and the duplicate-attendee case on their own. So no single comment needs more than s_0f78e9fc or s_969329e8 already says, and one edit in one place fixes everything. That is why needsUnifiedComment is false, which matches Judge 2.
